product_launches.description: Warba Bank launched a newly redesigned and fully upgraded Marketplace within its mobile banking app, adding lifestyle services, digital vouchers, gift cards, and exclusive partner offers in a unified interface.

press_references.value: Warba Bank launches “PULSE” to strengthen culture of operational excellence

product_launches.description: Warba Bank launched PULSE, an internal Lean Six Sigma-based capability-building and operational excellence program aimed at improving process efficiency and customer service quality.

press_references.value: Warba Bank launches Warba Invoice Gate to accelerate supplier invoice processing

product_launches.description: Warba Bank launched Warba Invoice Gate, a new digital platform to automate and speed up supplier invoice processing for its individual financing products.

press_references.value: Warba Bank launches first digital “Easy Finance” in Kuwait for domestic workers

product_launches.description: Warba Bank launched SiDi Easy Finance, Kuwait’s first fully digital micro-financing service for domestic workers (Article 20), offering KD 100/200/300 tiers with 3–9 month terms via the SiDi app, compliant with Sharia and local regulations.

press_references.value: Warba Bank launches youth account “Wave Banking”

product_launches.description: Warba Bank launched Wave Banking, a youth-focused digital account and platform featuring a prepaid Visa card with up to 3% cashback (capped at KWD 150/month), student rewards (Imtiyaz), weekly prizes, a youth marketplace, and budgeting tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Warba Bank is a banking and financial service provider company.

product.name: Personal Banking
product.description: Sharia-compliant banking for individuals, including transaction, salary, savings, investment, family, youth and gold accounts, along with financing, deposits and cards.

product.name: Warba Bank Mobile App
product.description: A mobile banking application for managing accounts and cards, transferring funds, using digital wallets, opening selected products and accessing budgeting and marketplace features.

product.name: Personal Islamic Financing
product.description: Sharia-compliant financing for vehicles, consumer purchases, housing, debt transfers, and eligible health and educational programs.

product.name: Corporate Banking Financing
product.description: Islamic corporate financing using Ijara, Commodity Murabaha, Forward Murabaha, letters of credit and bank guarantees for assets, operations, property and trade.

product.name: Corporate Banking Services
product.description: Business infrastructure services including corporate online banking, treasury, account integration, cash deposits, call accounts, deposits, payment cards, POS and payment gateways.

product.name: Business Banking
product.description: Banking and digital support for businesses, including business cards, online and mobile banking, operational services and access to third-party marketplace solutions.
